service.execution: correct local service under hits and reserved nonoverlapping blocks: assumption of model A; delta_execution is not a measured failure probability
service.calendar: e_kw=k*P+w*P/W; completion=e_kw+Delta; starts/ends restricted to [0,T] as in A

units.b: s^-1, total bit-marginal majorant for full code array
units.B: s^-1, upper bound on same majorant
units.E: expected excess count of majorant over T
units.S_A: s^-1, upper bound on integral(lambda_A^2 dt)

environment.interpretation: ASSUMPTION: jointly admissible b,B,E for lambda_A; not a physical transfer from CY62167 and not original B_max/F_s

probabilistic_assumptions.D: Atomic parent mark affects at least two distinct code bits in at least one full word; count the parent once, not cells/words/clusters.
probabilistic_assumptions.C: Remaining parents; each touches at most one code bit of each word; dependence across words inside a mark is allowed.
probabilistic_assumptions.pair_law: ASSUMPTION: pair-moment domination (6) of PR383; independently marked Poisson parents are one sufficient conditional model.
probabilistic_assumptions.spatial: ASSUMPTION: r_wi^C(t) <= lambda_A(t)/(n*W), first sufficient condition in section 4.1 of PR383.
probabilistic_assumptions.p_D: P(N_D(T)>=1) for the full array and horizon; UNKNOWN physical value
probabilistic_assumptions.Lambda_D: E[N_D(T)] for physical parents D; UNKNOWN physical value
probabilistic_assumptions.poisson_branch: Only when N_D(T) has a justified Poisson law with deterministic total mean; not an unconditional mixed-Poisson claim.

calendars.published_period_representation: Exact decimal Fraction(86,5), explicitly required by Issue; no binary64 replacement
calendars.resource_minimum_representation: Least finite binary64 P >= W*c/rho_bus and P > Delta; exact rational of selected value retained. Numeric representation, no hardware timer qualification.
